name: chat
about: A fresh network has no channel: the walk makes its own (qa-chat-<walk_tag>), then sends a message in it. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.

params.walk_tag: a short tag unique to this walk, e.g. the merge's short sha: it names what the walk makes so a later run can find it

steps.say: open the Chat tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Chat tab is selected and the chat view shows a New channel button; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading

steps.say: press New channel in the chat sidebar
steps.expect: a Create a channel card shows: a Channel name field, Voice room: Off and Members only: Off buttons, and Cancel and Create channel buttons

steps.say: type the channel name into the Channel name field
steps.expect: the Channel name field's value is qa-chat-{param:walk_tag} and Create channel is enabled (its state does not list disabled)
the Create a channel card is gone and the channel list shows a button named for qa-chat-{param:walk_tag} (a leading # is fine); no error sentence

steps.say: press the qa-chat-{param:walk_tag} channel in the channel list
steps.expect: the room header's name label reads qa-chat-{param:walk_tag} and the composer shows a Send button

steps.say: type a short message into the message composer
steps.expect: the Send button is enabled (its state does not list disabled)
a new message card appears in the timeline with an author label (a pending 'sending…' label is fine) and the Send button reports disabled again; no error sentence
